speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether he can provide an update on the number of neighbourhood centres that have been selected for Revitalisation of Shops (ROS) scheme since March 2024; and (b) whether HDB will consider increasing the funding of ROS given the rapid rise of construction costs in the last three years.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: So far, I have not gotten a response from HDB on this portion.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: We noted that there is a bit more grants for the shop front, but the total construction cost still remains an issue.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: Thirdly, for some of the shop owners, if they find that they have difficulty paying even the co-payment, is HDB prepared to allow them to pay by instalments?

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: And lastly, if the ROS is successfully implemented and some of the shop owners refuse to pay, what is the recourse that HDB has?

speaker: Ms Sim Ann
text: From my understanding, quite a few local working committees have already been set up, including in Mr Ang Wei Neng's area.

speaker: Ms Sim Ann
text: We also seek the advisors' support for encouraging the local merchant associations to work closely with us because their inputs are important.
